default.description: What the front end is allowed to ask the core to do. Without this file the webview has no permissions at all and every IPC call is denied, which is how the first probe came to report three failures it never actually tested. Every window is listed: a capability names the windows it applies to, and a window left out of that list gets no core permission at all. That has now happened twice. The settings window's 關閉 button did nothing; then the first-run download window could not `listen`, so its init() died on its first line -- no model list, no size, a progress bar that never moved and a 稍後再說 button that did nothing, while 開始下載 worked because commands this app defines itself are not gated by this file; only the `core:` ones are. A test in main.rs (`every_window_is_granted_the_core_permissions`) now fails if a window label is missing here.
